provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: ارفض ما لا تفهمه من الأرقام بصوت مسموع
title.en: Reject digits you do not understand, out loud

statement.ar: أي محرف لا يعرفه المحلل (أرقام نظام آخر، محرف خفي غير اتجاهي، حرف شبيه برقم) يُرفض برسالة تسمّيه. لا يُحذف بصمت ولا يُتجاهل.
statement.en: Any character the parser does not know (digits of another system, a non-directional invisible character, a letter that looks like a digit) is rejected with a message that names it. It is never silently deleted or ignored.

rationale.ar: الحذف الصامت يحوّل «1O0» إلى «10» و«12٫5» إلى «125» إن لم تُعرف الفاصلة. الرفض المعلن يكلّف المستخدم ثانية، والحذف يكلّفه مبلغًا خاطئًا.
rationale.en: Silent deletion turns "1O0" into "10" and "12٫5" into "125" when the separator is unknown. A stated rejection costs the person a second; deletion costs a wrong amount.

checks: amounts cases tagged other-numeral-system, invisible, exponent, currency-symbol: status invalid, error invalid-character.
phone-inputs PI-023 (Latin O for zero) is invalid-character.
The error message for invalid-character contains the offending character.
No numeric field strips characters on input other than bidi controls and surrounding whitespace.
